items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bross Woods was a very, very simple type of player... He was a very jovial person. Real nice cat. Everyone loved Bross.

ctx.x: We talked about a lot of – we talked about a number of St. Louis trumpet players, and I have a long list. I just want to go through them, and if you have a recollection or any thought about any of these people, maybe you could offer it. Bross Woods.

Bross Woods was a very, very simple type of player. Played very, very melodic and very lightly. Nothing powerful. He didn’t play real high, didn’t play real loud. Just played sort of in the groove. He was a very jovial person. Real nice cat. Everyone loved Bross. Bross Woods. I don’t even remember what his first real name was, but he was a Woods, and we all – everybody called him Bross Woods.
Was he your senior? A contemporary?
